description: Source code for crash generation server in Google Breakpad, implementing IPC server logic for crash dump handling on Windows.

classes.name: CrashGenerationServer
classes.description: Implements an IPC server for crash dump requests, managing client connections, requests, and dump generation.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the crash generation server, setting up IPC mechanisms.

methods.name: HandleConnectionRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming client connection requests based on server state machine.

methods.name: HandleDumpRequest
methods.description: Handles a crash dump request from a client, optionally generating a dump and invoking callback.

methods.name: GenerateDump
methods.description: Creates a minidump of the client process for crash analysis.
